sources.title: LFM2.5-230M - Liquid Docs
sources.snippet: Ultra-compact 230M parameter model for data extraction and lightweight on-device agentic tasks ← Back to Text Models LFM2.5-230M is Liquid AI's smallest LFM2.5 text model, designed for edge devices with the tightest memory and compute budgets.

sources.snippet: 230M multilingual bidirectional encoder for fine-tuning into classification, token classification, and retrieval tasks ← Back to Liquid Nanos LFM2.5-Encoder-230M is a multilingual bidirectional encoder built on the LFM2 architecture.
